OMG-best meal in Hanoi
Jan 2020
This was our best meal in Hanoi and Hanoi is a foodie paradise. If we stayed longer, we'd definitely go back. Their hot pots are to die for. We had the spicy mushroom stock with 3 kinds of mushrooms, Wagyu beef and Udon noodles. Couldn't believe it...they had morels and chanterelles. 

A special acknowledgment to the manager Khanh. We were the only westerners in the restaurant and he guided us through every step. GREAT SERVICE.

Thx for an incredible dinner.

Great food but no so great service
Aug 2018 • Friends
The food is great - a wide variety of mushrooms with some that I have not even tried before. Boiling the soup with the mushrooms over time thickens and enhances the fragrance of the soup. It was a really pleasant meal (taste wise).

Unfortunately the service could be much better. The food took a long time to arrive and some of the ingredients of our hotpot weren't even given to us until we asked about it. Most of the staff could not converse in English and were unable to understand us. They were not as attentive as we would like and whatever we asked for (be it food, soup refills, bill) it took a much longer time to come (as compared to other tables who were Vietnamese patrons). 

1 strange thing we noticed was that people were allowed to smoke in the restaurant? The person (not sure if it was a staff or customer) was standing behind our table (we were only separated by an uncovered window sill of sorts) and smoking. The cigarette smoke affected the smell and taste of the food we were eating - luckily this happened towards the end of our meal so our taste buds weren't affected from the beginning.
